edges.description: The affected residues lie in the catalytic core of a helicase whose essential cellular job is small-subunit ribosome assembly.

edges.limitations: Reported defects are a smaller testis with vacuolated seminiferous tubules and impaired spermatogenesis — a postnatal spermatogenic failure in an animal that still forms a testis. The human disease is a failure of fetal testis determination or its loss before birth, with undervirilized or female external genitalia. No sex reversal, no anorchia, and no undervirilization are reported in the model, so the defining human phenotype is absent.

nodes.description: Postnatally there is no gonad capable of steroid or peptide hormone output. Gonadotropin feedback is unopposed, producing hypergonadotropic hypogonadism with undetectable anti-Müllerian hormone and inhibin B, low baseline testosterone, and no testosterone rise after hCG stimulation. Puberty does not occur spontaneously.

nodes.description: Surgical management covers two distinct situations. Where dysgenetic gonadal tissue carrying Y-chromosome material is present, gonadectomy addresses germ-cell tumour risk. Where the finding is a regression remnant or nubbin, excision is offered on a contested rationale — the malignant potential of such remnants is extrapolated from cryptorchidism and viable germ cells are found in only a minority — and practice varies. Testicular prostheses are commonly requested and are part of the same operative discussion.

Incremental testosterone induces and sustains puberty in individuals raised male and must be continued lifelong to prevent the skeletal and cardiovascular consequences of hypogonadism. Statural growth and pubertal development are adequate even when replacement starts in late adolescence, which usefully leaves time to explore gender identity before committing. Penile growth is the exception: it remains suboptimal in many, and especially so in DHX37 carriers, where restriction persists into adulthood. Earlier infantile testosterone to mimic mini-puberty has been proposed to improve this, but was less effective in DHX37 carriers than in others.

nodes.description: Nucleolar stress releases p53 from MDM2-mediated restraint, and apoptosis of the gonadal somatic compartment follows. This is the proposed route to the regression pole of the spectrum: a gonad that has already formed is subsequently lost, rather than never being built. It rests on mouse and cell-line data plus a proposed model; no human gonadal measurement supports it, hence PROVISIONAL.

biological_processes: p53-mediated intrinsic apoptosis of gonadal somatic cells

evidence.reference_title: Multi-omics analysis the effects of Dhx37 deficiency on testis development and nucleolar homeostasis.
evidence.snippet: In the Dhx37-/- mice, we observed pronounced defects, including diminished testicular volume, lower testosterone levels, and marked vacuolization of the seminiferous tubules.
